searchText: Yes, every node has a full copy of the entire state of Ethereum. Essentially replication factor of as many nodes as there are in the network. As to whether each node stores state in memory or on disk is dependent on the specific client, but most store everything on disk with perhaps some in memory caching for performance optimization.
